intro.text: Welcome, hero! You are standing on a warm pink cotton candy cloud. Suddenly, your friend 'Flying Teapot' zooms over, shaking, and says: 'Oh no! The magical Rainbow Star fell into the Gray Bubble Valley! If we don't save it, the clouds will lose their colors and sweetness forever!'

choices.text: Go to Principal Marshmallow's office for help
Go directly to the Whispering Windmill for directions

marshmallow_office.text: You enter Principal Marshmallow's giant office. He wears round glasses and looks very worried. He says: 'How brave of you! Take this magical Star Catcher wand. It will help you pull far objects closer. Go, and cross the Chocolate River to reach the valley!'

choices.text: Take the wand and head to the hot Chocolate River

whispering_windmill.text: You climb the Whispering Windmill. The wind whistles a sweet melody. Next to the gears, you find a shiny 'Gold Windup Key'. The wind whispers: 'The magic forest lies ahead. Use this key to power the mechanical ladybug and fly over!'

choices.text: Take the key and head to the Candy Forest

chocolate_river.text: You arrive at the Chocolate River. Delicious hot chocolate flows, making sweet brown bubbles! But there is no bridge to cross.

choices.text: Use the Star Catcher to pull a marshmallow boat closer
Try to build a bridge out of scattered biscuit planks

boat_success.text: You sail smoothly on the soft marshmallow boat! Suddenly, a friendly chocolate whale appears and blows a cold cocoa fountain! The whale laughs and gifts you a glowing 'Magic Pearl' for your bravery.

choices.text: Continue sailing towards Cotton Candy Mountain

bridge_puzzle.text: Let's build a bridge! Use your camera to scan the room and place the magic biscuit blocks to cross safely.

prompt_text.ar: ضع لوح البسكويت على الأرض وقم بتكبيره للمرور
prompt_text.en: Place the biscuit plank on the floor and resize it to cross

choices.text: Cross the biscuit bridge safely

candy_forest.text: You enter the Candy Forest. The trees are made of giant lollipops, and the leaves are sweet peppermint! But the path is blocked by thick sugary branches.

choices.text: Use the key to fly over on the mechanical ladybug
Ask the Gummy Bear King for permission to pass

ladybug_flight.text: You ride the mechanical ladybug high above the pink trees! From the sky, you spot a glowing fruit on a peppermint branch. You pick it carefully: it's a 'Rainbow Fruit'!

choices.text: Land the ladybug at the foot of Cotton Candy Mountain

gummy_king.text: The giant, friendly Gummy Bear King blocks your way. He chuckles: 'Hello little hero! I will let you pass only if you solve my riddle: What is the one thing that becomes bigger and sweeter the more you share it with friends?'

choices.text: The answer is: Delicious candies!
The answer is: A smile and friendship!

gummy_retry.text: The King shakes his head with a smile: 'No, little adventurer! Candies run out when shared. Think of something magical that never shrinks but grows!'

choices.text: Try to answer again

gummy_success.text: The King claps happily: 'Brilliant! A smile and friendship are the ultimate treasure!' He opens the path and hands you a gummy shield to protect you.

choices.text: Go forward to Cotton Candy Mountain

cotton_candy_mountain.text: Ahead stands the Gray Cloud Castle atop Cotton Candy Mountain. It is guarded by sleeping gingerbread cookie soldiers.

choices.text: Try to sneak quietly past the sleeping guards
Use the secret Bubble Portal to enter

bubble_portal.text: The portal is locked by magic bubbles! Use your camera to pop the correct bubble and open the secret entrance to the castle.

prompt_text.ar: فرقع الفقاعة الذهبية السحرية بلمسها لفتح الباب
prompt_text.en: Pop the magic golden bubble by tapping it to unlock the door

choices.text: Enter the throne room after popping the bubbles

front_gate.text: The gingerbread guards are moving in their sleep! You must cross the bridge quickly and quietly before they wake up! You have 8 seconds!

choices.text: Sneak quickly over the fragile bridge

core_room.text: You enter the dark throne room. In the center sits the lonely Gray Cloud, crying. The Rainbow Star is stuck on his head, completely dark. He weeps: 'I am not bad... I am just lonely, and nobody wants to play with me because I am gray!'

choices.text: Give him the glowing Magic Pearl from your bag
Give him the glowing Rainbow Fruit from your bag
Give him a warm hug and offer to be his best friend
Tell him a funny joke to make him laugh

perfect_ending.text: When you hand him the glowing magical gift, he gasps with joy, and the star shines bright with rainbow colors! The Gray Cloud transforms into a happy white cloud. Sweet colors return to the academy, and you are crowned the Rainbow Guardian!

hug_ending.text: You hug the soft Gray Cloud. He feels warm and begins to cry colorful tears that turn into flying butterflies! The star glows, and he promises to be a friendly white cloud forever. Ending: Warm Cloud Friendship

joke_ending.text: You tell a funny joke about biscuits and chocolate. The cloud bursts into laughter, raining colorful candies everywhere! The star lights up, and he reconciles with everyone. Ending: Rainbow Laughter

captured_party.text: The gingerbread guards wake up and catch you! You enter the castle scared, but suddenly they shout: 'Surprise!' It turns out the Gray Cloud was preparing a surprise birthday party but was too shy to invite anyone. He returns the star with joy! Ending: The Great Cloud Party
